note: Labels were written by hand from the listing text. They were not produced by a similarity score, a duplicate detector, or the FitRank ranker. A future detector should be scored against these labels and must not rewrite them.

labels.similar_style: Different underlying items with related attributes. This is not a duplicate and not a conflict.
labels.probable_duplicate: Two listings of the same underlying item that agree on every declared field: category, colour, material, silhouette, price, and currency.
labels.attribute_conflict: Two listings of the same underlying item that disagree on at least one declared field. The disagreement is the label. The values are not averaged.
labels.unrelated: Different underlying items in different categories. A control pair, so a future detector can be penalised for calling them the same item.
